description: A nursing supervisor must finalize overnight coverage for two hospital units that need different kinds of support, using one critical-care float nurse and coordinating with the staffing office and respiratory therapy.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one overnight critical-care float nurse available for the 20:00 to 08:00 shift.
shared_context.S2: Unit East and Unit West both need an overnight coverage plan finalized before the evening shift begins.
shared_context.S3: Maya, the nursing supervisor, makes the binding coverage assignment.
shared_context.S4: Hospital practice is for the nursing supervisor to conduct a brief operational huddle with staffing and respiratory therapy before finalizing an overnight coverage plan.

PF1.text: The Unit East patient will remain on temporary pacing from 22:00 to 06:00, and the available float nurse, Lee, is the only nurse on tonight's roster credentialed to manage temporary pacing; the staffing office roster records this qualification and timing.

PF2.text: The Unit West patient requires noninvasive-ventilation checks every two hours overnight, and respiratory therapist Mateo is the only respiratory therapist on duty qualified for that equipment; Mateo has confirmed coverage from exactly 20:00 to 08:00.

acceptance_conditions: The critical-care float nurse must be assigned to Unit East.
The float assignment must cover the full 20:00 to 08:00 shift.
The temporary-pacing coverage window must be recorded as exactly 22:00 to 06:00.
Unit West must have qualified respiratory-therapy coverage from exactly 20:00 to 08:00.
The Unit West respiratory-therapy provider must be recorded as Mateo.
The Unit West respiratory-therapy coverage must be documented as part of the finalized plan.
The temporary-pacing staffing fact must be cited as justification for assigning the float nurse to Unit East.

content_checks.C4: ('noninvasive-ventilation' in decisions['unit_west_coverage_role'] or 'respiratory therapy' in decisions['unit_west_coverage_role'] or 'NIV' in decisions['unit_west_coverage_role']) and 'Mateo' in decisions['unit_west_coverage_provider'] and decisions['unit_west_coverage_start'] == '20:00' and decisions['unit_west_coverage_end'] == '08:00'

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The temporary-pacing requirement and Lee's qualification change the assignment unit to Unit East and fix the pacing coverage window at exactly 22:00-06:00.

The two-hour noninvasive-ventilation checks and Mateo's confirmed qualification change Unit West's plan to Mateo's qualified respiratory-therapy coverage from exactly 20:00-08:00 and require that coverage to be marked documented.
